Over the Boolean-only base through D>=2r+3, their individual squarefree leading-kernel ideals in one graded-lex order all equal(t1,t2), while the actual intersection kernel has degree polynomial(2z+z²)^r and first degree r. Thus forming leading ideals does not commute with kernel intersection. A simultaneous affine coordinate change restores the cover model; known degree-one coefficient maps kill every companion with weight1.
